scenes.say: Tesla Powerwall three or FranklinWH aPower two? Let's settle it.
Storage: FranklinWH wins, fifteen kilowatt-hours versus thirteen point five.
Continuous power: Powerwall wins, eleven point five kilowatts versus ten.
Warranty: FranklinWH, fifteen years versus ten, plus built-in generator integration.
Getting new solar? Powerwall three is usually cheaper, because the inverter is built in.
Already have solar? FranklinWH is a strong choice for adding storage.
Choosing a whole-home battery? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
